productIntent.goal: AI-native, modular, industry-agnostic Enterprise Operating System where enterprise activity can be executed, explained, replayed, upgraded, and continuously evolved.

currentStage.name: Financial Statement Readiness
currentStage.businessGoal: Govern accounting periods, reconcile economic ledgers to GL, and define versioned projection metadata so the three core financial statements can be generated from authoritative accounting state.

activeRequirementSet.name: Accounting Period + Reconciliation + Statement Projection Metadata
acceptance: configured accounting periods do not overlap
normal journal posting requires an OPEN accounting period
closed period rejects new Journal/JournalLine atomically
explicit REPLAY mode may rebuild derived GL state across closed periods
economic/subledger amount is aggregated independently from ledger_entry
GL account amount is aggregated independently from JournalLine
Balance Sheet, Income Statement and Cash Flow Statement definitions are versioned metadata
account-to-statement mappings reference real versioned statement lines
cash-flow classification is driven by BusinessData/accounting lineage semantics and references a versioned cash-flow statement line
financial statements remain projections and never become an independent fact source
verified: FAI-01/02 strict double-entry is DATABASE E2E VERIFIED
FAI-03~05 recognition / trace / Trial Balance / GL Replay is DATABASE E2E VERIFIED by PR #47 / CI #668
Asloop legacy semantics confirm account-balance + report-mapping projection design
open: GL/economic reconciliation MATCH and MISMATCH proof
deferred: actual Balance Sheet projection until FAI-06 closes
actual Income Statement projection until FAI-06 closes
actual Cash Flow Statement projection until FAI-06 closes
bank reconciliation beyond core ledger-to-GL proof

antiOverdesignQuestions: Which confirmed current requirement needs this?
What acceptance gate is blocked if we do not build it now?
Can an existing mechanism satisfy the need more simply?
Is this current necessity or mainly hypothetical future flexibility?
alignmentTriggers: every 3 completed verified work packets since last alignment
proposal to generalize a local mechanism

lastAlignment.reason: EEL-C04 completed and mandatory completed-loop requirement-alignment trigger fired.
lastAlignment.result: EEL-C05 Inventory Transfer selected because it adds a new internal-asset conservation proof without requiring statutory accounting expansion or WMS/TMS platformization.

alignmentCadence.countingRule: Count merged bounded slices whose evidence level is DATABASE E2E VERIFIED or CERTIFIED.
alignmentCadence.triggerRule: Run formal alignment at the third slice or any mandatory event trigger, whichever comes first.
alignmentCadence.resetRule: Reset the slice counter after a formal alignment review is recorded in lastAlignment.

nextRequirementSelection.selection: FAI-06 Accounting Period + Reconciliation + Statement Projection Metadata
nextRequirementSelection.rule: After FAI-06 is green, move directly to FAI-07 three core financial statements as ledger/GL projections.

findings: legacy Asloop/bookkeeping semantics include explicit debit/credit concepts
current EVO generic ledger uses signed quantity/amount and does not enforce balanced journals
financial accounting must be layered as an explicit General Ledger projection rather than forcing operational ledgers into debit/credit terminology
invariants: each General Ledger journal has at least one debit and one credit line
sum(debit) equals sum(credit) under pinned accounting precision
financial statements derive from authoritative accounting state and never rewrite canonical BusinessData
financialAccountingIntegrity.primaryRequirement: 有借必有贷、借贷必相等
